goal: Den kleinsten read-only Database-Readiness-Vertrag aus vorhandenen nicht mutierenden Signalen festlegen, ohne CP-03/CP-08 oder Storage zu reopen

guide_delta.summary: I74 trennt allgemeine Lesebereitschaft strikt von pre_write_gate und autorisiert als minimale Readiness nur Datenbank-Erreichbarkeit plus bestehende Schema-Identitaet; keine neue HealthLevel-Abbildung und kein Provider.

tests_required: confirm assert_schema_identity is non-mutating and checks version, application identity, tables and schema fingerprint
confirm pre_write_gate adds write-only conditions and is therefore excluded
confirm no new HealthLevel mapping or provider is introduced
Manifest V2 and strict write_files scope validation green
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
pre_write_gate because write readiness is out of scope
database regressions because storage is untouched
full suite because I74 is scope-only
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: schema identity proves compatibility but not full data integrity
mapping readiness failures to HealthLevel remains intentionally unauthorized
non_changes: no events, writer lifecycle, Composition Root or starter
expected_side_effects: minimal read-only readiness boundary becomes explicit
next iteration can decide one thin provider without importing write-readiness semantics
